name: Valid PO required
rule: Every invoice must reference a valid purchase order (PO) number.

name: Amount within PO tolerance
rule: Invoice total must be within 2% of the PO amount. Anything above needs review.

name: Payment terms match contract
rule: Payment terms on the invoice must match the vendor contract terms.

name: No duplicate invoices
rule: Same vendor + same invoice number, or same vendor + same amount within 30 days, is a duplicate.

name: Valid GST number
rule: Invoice must show the vendor's GSTIN and it must match the vendor master record.

name: Approval thresholds
rule: Under ₹50,000: Team Manager. ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000: Finance Controller. Above ₹5,00,000: CFO.
